zones.name: The Marrowfields
zones.tagline: Pale water, pale reeds, patient things.
zones.entry: The bell-yard road drowns softly into the reed-beds.

objective.text: String bell-cords along the safe paths home.

zones.name: The Chime Deep
zones.tagline: A drowned basilica. Ten thousand bells, all silent.
zones.entry: The water goes chest-high, then faithful. The bells hang all the way down.

objective.text: Silence one of the great bells by hand, so it can never be rung against us.

zones.name: The Requiem Scar
zones.tagline: Where the great bell fell. The ground still hums.
zones.entry: Down the crater rim, where the bronze ran and cooled.
zones.loot_hint: Bellforged things — and, rarely, a Requiem

objective.text: Reach the crater floor and lay a hand on the fallen bell.

zones.name: The Lantern Wastes
zones.tagline: The last lights burn for things that hunt them.
zones.entry: Beyond the fallen bell, a chain of lanterns leads across black glass. Something moves between the flames.
zones.loot_hint: Two fights per toll · Bellforged and Requiem relics

objective.text: Relight the watchtower before the last pilgrim lamp goes dark.

travel_lines: The lamps lean away as %s passes. There is no wind.
Glass sings underfoot. Ahead, another light goes out.
The watchtower is nearer now. Its shadow has not moved.
discovery_lines: Coins tucked into a cold lantern. A toll paid to nobody.
Under the glass: a pilgrim's purse, still tied shut.
An offering at a nameless marker. The road gives a little back.
